title: Corporate Sector Coverage & Financial Institutions Intern (Wholesale Banking, Manila Branch)
full_description:
City of Taguig, Philippines
ING WB Asia Internship Programme 2026
At ING, we’re redefining what it means to be a bank and we’re looking for people with the right skills to jump on. If you’re a smart, driven student with global ambitions who wants to make a real difference, our internship might be for you.
Position:Corporate Sector Coverage & Financial Institutions Intern (Wholesale Banking, Manila Branch)
Dept/Function:Corporate Sector Coverage & Financial Institutions
Internship Period:March 2026 onwards. Full time for 5 Months.
The world of banking is changing faster than ever. That’s why we at ING are always broadening our horizons. Our people have a forward-thinking mentality, a strong can-do spirit and enjoy working in an agile environment.
In Asia Pacific, ING offers wholesale banking across 11 markets, namely Australia, China, Hong Kong SAR, India, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam. ING offers both retail and wholesale banking services in Australia. The bank also started its digital banking platform in the Philippines in 2018. ING's regional presence includes a 13% stake in Bank of Beijing, China and a 23% stake in TMBThanachart Bank, Thailand.
What does the Corporate Sector Coverage and Financial Institutions Coverage Team do in ING?
The Corporate Sector Coverage and Financial Institutions Coverage represent the relationship team for corporate clients and financial institutions.
As relationship managers, we cultivate long term relationships with our clients and leverage our deep understanding and knowledge of their needs and potential opportunities to offer a broad range of banking products
We work closely with other teams in the bank, particularly product specialists (Financial Markets, Capital Markets, Corporate Finance, Specialized Lending, Lending, Transaction Services, etc.)
What would you be doing?
An intern in the CSC and FI team will be expected to support/help/assist account managers in:
preparing account plans, client briefs, strategy papers, presentation decks, sector/industry and market research and analysis, and financial analysis and other miscellaneous reports;
preparing account plans, client briefs, strategy papers, presentation decks, sector/industry and market research and analysis, and financial analysis and other miscellaneous reports;
preparing and conducting Know-Your-Customer (KYC) and client due diligence (CDD), including onboarding of new clients, reviewing and researching on clients for due diligence, financial analysis, and identifying product opportunities;
